entries.title: Started a stupid company. Failed.
entries.author: themanthatfell
entries.excerpt: Ran out of money. Ran out of credit. Losing house in two months (already foreclosed). Wife pregnant. Three kids all under 6. Pretty sure I am the opposite of everyone here. I am no man. Just a statistic. Everything is gone. Selling spare parts to keep the lights on. It was a nice fantasy, HN. To the rest of you: fight hard and good luck.
entries.guide_zh: 一位创业失败者讲述资金耗尽、住房被收回及养家压力交织的困境。

entries.title: Hey developers, stop forcing me to login to unsubscribe
entries.author: andrewhillman
entries.current_title: Hey developers, stop forcing me to login to unsubscribe
entries.excerpt: Dear Sender: There's nothing more annoying than clicking that 'unsubscribe' link at the bottom of your email only to be asked to login first. I know it sucks when people opt-out of your transactional emails, but deal with it and let people unsubscribe with one click. If you do this you may even get some valuable feedback. entries.guide_zh: 退订邮件却被要求先登录，作者请求开发者停止这种让人烦躁的设计。

entries.title: Ask HN: Google employees, why is G+ more important than your users?
entries.author: dsl
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Google employees, why is G+ more important than your users?

entries.title: Ask HN: I'm 15, won a grant to develop a suicide prevention app, what next?
entries.author: krrishd
entries.current_title: Ask HN: I'm 15, won a grant to develop a suicide prevention app, what next?
entries.excerpt: Some background: I'm 15 years old, attend high school, do well in terms of grades and extracurriculars (business clubs/competitions), and also am a pretty good front-end developer experienced with HTML/Jade,CSS/LESS, JS/jQuery/AngularJS, and Phonegap/Cordova. I've worked on several web projects in the past, such as http://teen2geek.com, and my portfolio is at http://krrishd.github.io, just to get an idea of what I can do in web development (not so good at the backend though).
entries.guide_zh: 十五岁学生获得自杀预防应用资助后，想知道接下来该如何推进。

entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (November 2013)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please lead with the location of the position and include the keywords INTERN, REMOTE, or H1B if the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome.
